title.narrative: Promoting a More Inclusive and Accountable Democracy in Liberia

description.narrative:
The Overall Objective of this Action is to promote a more inclusive and transparent democracy in Liberia. The Action will have three specific objectives:

i.   Support the electoral cycle and sustain peace;

ii.    Enable the meaningful participation of women and inclusion of marginalised groups in political processes; and

iii.   Increase the participation of citizens in the decision-making process and accountability (through increased legislative oversight).

description.narrative: The indicator will track and identify the number of women candidates nominated or appointed in political parties leadership

comment.narrative: 30 Gender quota is voluntary. The electoral reform bill which includes a mandatory 30 gender quota was not approved by the executive. For the 2023 elections 22 out of 25 political parties signed an MOU committing to a minimum of 30 gender representation. However during candidate registration the major political parties failed to uphold their commitments with only two smaller parties achieving the 30 threshold.

Annual report 2023 indicator value date 31122023The system did not accept the correct indicator value date and requested to choose a date after 14102024.Given the current status of implementation it is premature to report on the contribution to objectives measured in accordance with the performance indicators.A huge delaying factor to advance with the project is the promoter and the national procurement agency capacity in terms of procurement. Decisions taken by the promoter which is sovereign in terms of decision as long as it respects the EIB guide to procurement has led to cancellation of a procurement process hydrogeological study and subsequent delays on this activity. The process followed by the national procurement authority to approve any procurement stage is very long and although this issue was specifically underlined during the monitoring visit in May 2023 no progress has been made. The cancellation of the detailed design contract initially had a major impact on the project timeline. However EIB has been able to rapidly adapt the project to the situation thus the cancellation should not lead to any potential further disruption and delays.
